test.title: Why songs stay in the memory

paragraphs.text: Most people can recall the words of a song they have not heard for years, even when they struggle to remember what they did last week. Psychologists at the University of Lindmark set out to discover why musical memories seem so durable.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: In one experiment, volunteers learned short poems, some spoken and some sung to simple tunes. A week later, the sung poems were remembered almost twice as well. The researchers believe that melody gives the brain a second route to the words: if one route fails, the other may still work.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: A second study looked at people with memory loss caused by illness. Many could not name family members, yet they sang along to songs from their youth. Such cases suggest that musical memory is stored in parts of the brain that are damaged later than others.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The team also found a disadvantage. Songs learned by heart can become stuck, repeating in the mind for hours. This was most common among people who were tired or stressed, and least common among those concentrating on a demanding task.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: Why songs stay in the memory

items.quote: A week later, the sung poems were remembered almost twice as well
items.prompt: In the first experiment, the poems that were sung

options.text: were remembered much better a week later.

explanation.en: “A week later, the sung poems were remembered almost twice as well” → B. Speed of learning (A) and understanding (D) are not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «A week later, the sung poems were remembered almost twice as well» → B. Жаттау жылдамдығы (A) мен түсіну (D) туралы бір сөз жоқ.
explanation.ru: «A week later, the sung poems were remembered almost twice as well» → B. О скорости заучивания (A) и понимании (D) нет ни слова.

items.quote: melody gives the brain a second route to the words
items.prompt: The researchers explain this result by suggesting that melody

options.text: makes the words easier to pronounce.
provides an extra way of recalling the words.

explanation.en: “melody gives the brain a second route to the words” → D: “an extra way of recalling” = “a second route”. The other options sound reasonable but are not in the text.
explanation.kk: «melody gives the brain a second route to the words» → D: «an extra way of recalling» = «a second route». Қалған нұсқалар қисынды естілгенімен, мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «melody gives the brain a second route to the words» → D: «an extra way of recalling» = «a second route». Остальные варианты звучат разумно, но в тексте их нет.

items.quote: Many could not name family members, yet they sang along to songs from their youth
items.prompt: The study of people with memory loss found that many of them

options.text: remembered the names of family members.
could sing songs from when they were young.
preferred new songs to old ones.

explanation.en: “Many could not name family members, yet they sang along to songs from their youth” → C. B is the trap: they had forgotten family names.
explanation.kk: «Many could not name family members, yet they sang along to songs from their youth» → C. B — тұзақ: олар туыстарының есімін дәл ұмытқан.
explanation.ru: «Many could not name family members, yet they sang along to songs from their youth» → C. B — ловушка: имена родных они как раз забыли.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–3. Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.quote: This was most common among people who were tired or stressed
items.prompt: Which TWO situations make it more likely that a song gets stuck in someone’s mind?

explanation.en: “most common among people who were tired or stressed” → A and D. C is the opposite: with a demanding task it was “least common”. B and E are not in the text.
explanation.kk: «most common among people who were tired or stressed» → A және D. C — керісінше: күрделі тапсырма кезінде бұл «least common». B мен E мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «most common among people who were tired or stressed» → A и D. C — обратное: при сложной задаче застревание было «least common». B и E в тексте нет.
